name: Health Boost
text: Raises maximum health; level 3 adds 50. Particularly useful before four-piece Fatalis health benefits.

name: Divine Blessing
text: Sometimes reduces damage taken. Secret set bonuses can extend its level cap.

name: Stun Resistance
text: Reduces stun duration and prevents stun at the full normal level.

name: Evade Window
text: Extends invulnerability during supported evasions; timing still matters.

name: Evade Extender
text: Increases travel distance of supported evasions. Can change spacing as well as safety.

name: Weakness Exploit
text: Adds affinity on suitable weak parts, with additional benefit on wounds in current versions.

name: Critical Eye
text: Adds affinity without requiring an enraged target or a particular part.

name: Critical Boost
text: Raises physical critical-hit damage. Does not itself enable elemental critical hits.

name: Agitator
text: Boosts attack and affinity while the large monster is enraged.

name: Attack Boost
text: Adds physical attack, with additional affinity at relevant higher levels.

name: Handicraft
text: Can extend a weapon’s sharpness gauge up to its supported limit.

name: Protective Polish
text: Temporarily prevents sharpness loss after sharpening.

name: Master’s Touch
text: Set bonus: supported critical hits avoid sharpness consumption.

name: Focus
text: Speeds up supported charge actions or gauges; the benefit varies by weapon.

name: Power Prolonger
text: Extends supported powered states; check which state your weapon actually uses.

name: Guard
text: Reduces knockback and stamina loss while guarding compatible attacks.

name: Guard Up
text: Enables guarding of additional attacks, but does not make every attack blockable.

name: Artillery
text: Improves supported explosive attacks such as applicable shelling and impact phials; not elemental phials.

name: Capacity Boost
text: Adds capacity for compatible Charge Blade and Gunlance systems.

name: Constitution
text: Reduces stamina spent by supported fixed-cost actions.

name: Stamina Surge
text: Improves stamina recovery, helping stamina-heavy attack loops.

name: Marathon Runner
text: Reduces continuous stamina consumption for supported actions.

name: Bow Charge Plus
text: Adds an additional supported Bow charge level; check your setup’s source.

name: Normal / Piercing / Spread Shots
text: Boosts the matching supported shot or ammo category, rather than all ranged damage.

name: Free Elem / Ammo Up
text: Can unlock hidden element/status or increase compatible ammunition capacity; effects depend on the weapon.

name: Partbreaker
text: Improves relevant part damage toward breaks. It does not directly multiply all monster HP damage.

name: Wide-Range
text: Shares supported item effects with nearby teammates; not every consumable is shared.

name: Free Meal
text: Gives supported consumables a chance not to be consumed.

name: Clutch Claw Boost
text: Improves the weapon’s clutch attack utility; an Iceborne skill.

name: Geologist
text: Adds certain gathering opportunities; useful for many Guiding Lands monster-drop pickups.

name: Effluvia Resistance
text: Prevents the relevant effluvial buildup at sufficient levels; distinguish it from environmental effluvium protection.
